主页 · 总体介绍Home · Introduction

《EPIC: The Musical》（常写作 EPIC）是波多黎各裔音乐人豪尔赫·里维拉-埃兰斯（Jorge Rivera-Herrans）创作并制片的一部“全唱式”（sung-through）概念专辑音乐剧，改编自荷马史诗《奥德赛》。全剧以九张被称为“Saga（章节）”的概念专辑形式呈现，共 40 首歌曲，分为两幕，完整重述了伊萨卡国王奥德修斯在特洛伊战争结束后、历经二十载艰险归乡的故事。本剧于 2021 年通过社交媒体 TikTok 走红，2022 年底至 2024 年底陆续发行完毕，凭借动人的旋律、复杂的人物塑造与新颖的“边写边发布”制作模式，成为近年最具现象级影响力的音乐剧项目之一。

EPIC: The Musical (often styled EPIC) is a fully sung-through concept-album musical created and produced by Puerto Rican musician Jorge Rivera-Herrans, adapted from Homer's epic poem The Odyssey. The story unfolds across nine concept albums — each called a "Saga" — with 40 songs in two acts, retelling in full the tale of King Odysseus of Ithaca, who after the Trojan War endures twenty arduous years trying to return home. The project went viral on TikTok in 2021 and its installments were released from late 2022 to late 2024. Through moving melodies, complex character writing, and an innovative "release-while-writing-in-public" model, it has become one of the most phenomenal musical projects of recent years.

OVERVIEWOVERVIEW

一、作品概览1. Overview

EPIC 的叙事围绕奥德修斯“回家”这一核心展开，在忠实《奥德赛》主线的基础上做了大量现代改编：既保留希腊神话的宏大场面，又以贴近当代人心的方式刻画奥德修斯的人性挣扎。全剧巧用“主题动机”（leitmotif）与专属乐器来标识人物——奥德修斯以吉他、雅典娜以钢琴、风神埃俄洛斯以合唱与长笛等——让观众仅凭听觉就能辨认同一位角色与故事走向。

EPIC's narrative centers on Odysseus's "homecoming." While staying faithful to the main line of The Odyssey, it makes bold modern choices: it keeps the grand scale of Greek myth while portraying Odysseus's human struggle in ways that speak to a contemporary audience. The show uses leitmotifs and character-specific instruments to identify figures — Odysseus by guitar, Athena by piano, Aeolus by choral voices and flutes — so listeners can recognize a character and the story's direction through sound alone.

THE PLOTTHE PLOT

二、剧情介绍2. The Plot

特洛伊战争十年后，伊萨卡国王奥德修斯率六百名船员扬帆归乡。归途横亘着独眼巨人、暴风海神、魔女、冥界、塞壬与诸神的阻挠，他在一次次取舍中不断付出代价，最终在第二十年回到妻儿身边。全剧两幕、九个章节依次铺开这条残酷而深情的归乡之路。

After ten years of the Trojan War, King Odysseus of Ithaca sets sail for home with six hundred men. The journey is barred by the Cyclops, the raging sea-god, a sorceress, the underworld, Sirens, and the whims of the gods. Time and again he pays a heavy price for each choice, and only in the twentieth year does he finally return to his wife and son. The two acts and nine sagas trace this cruel yet deeply loving road home.

（一）第一幕：归途的开始Act 1 · The Beginning of the Journey

1. 特洛伊之章1. The Troy Saga

奥德修斯以“木马计”攻陷特洛伊。城中，宙斯降下神谕：若他不杀死赫克托尔之子、婴儿阿斯提阿纳克斯，此子将来必复仇于其家族。奥德修斯在痛苦与犹疑中做出抉择（《The Horse and the Infant》《Just a Man》）。战后他与挚友波利忒斯登岛觅食，波利忒斯劝他以善意面对世界（《Full Speed Ahead》《Open Arms》）；智慧女神雅典娜见他竟不施暴于人，斥其背离自己教导的战士之道，并以两人少年初遇的记忆点醒他（《Warrior of the Mind》）。

Odysseus takes Troy by the famous wooden horse. Inside the city, Zeus sends a vision: unless he kills the infant Astyanax, son of the Trojan prince Hector, the boy will one day seek vengeance on Odysseus and his family. He wrestles with the choice (The Horse and the Infant, Just a Man). After the war, he and his closest friend Polites land on an island for food; Polites urges him to face the world with open arms (Full Speed Ahead, Open Arms). Athena, goddess of wisdom and war, sees him refuse to use violence and chides him for straying from her teachings, replaying the memory of their first meeting to remind him of her expectations (Warrior of the Mind).

2. 独眼巨人之章2. The Cyclops Saga

一行人误入独眼巨人波吕斐摩斯的洞穴，杀羊充饥触怒巨人，多名船员被巨人吞食。奥德修斯假称自己名叫“无人（Nobody）”，灌醉并刺瞎巨人后率队仓皇逃离（《Polyphemus》《Survive》《Remember Them》《My Goodbye》）。愤怒的巨人向父神波塞冬哭诉，海神由此记下仇恨。

The crew stumbles into the cave of the one-eyed giant Polyphemus and kills a sheep for food, enraging him; several men are devoured. Odysseus tricks the Cyclops into believing his name is "Nobody," intoxicates and blinds him, then flees with the survivors (Polyphemus, Survive, Remember Them, My Goodbye). The enraged giant cries out to his father, the sea-god Poseidon, who nurses a grudge from that moment on.

3. 海洋之章3. The Ocean Saga

归途遭遇海上暴风（《Storm》）；副手欧律洛科斯出于好奇打开风袋，放出被收存的风暴（《Luck Runs Out》）；风神埃俄洛斯告诫奥德修斯连亲近之人也要提防（《Keep Your Friends Close》）；波塞冬现身为子复仇，击沉除奥德修斯座船外的整支舰队，六百人锐减至四十三人（《Ruthlessness》）。

The fleet is struck by a storm (Storm). The second-in-command Eurylochus, out of curiosity, opens the bag of winds and releases the trapped storm (Luck Runs Out). Aeolus warns Odysseus to beware even those closest to him (Keep Your Friends Close). Poseidon appears to avenge his son and sinks the entire fleet except Odysseus's own ship — six hundred men reduced to forty-three (Ruthlessness).

4. 喀耳刻之章4. The Circe Saga

登岛后，魔女喀耳刻把探路的船员变成猪（《Puppeteer》）。赫尔墨斯赠予魔草护身，奥德修斯抗住魔法并与喀耳刻斗智斗勇（《Wouldn't You Like》《Done For》），最终以坦诚说服魔女放行，并从她口中得到前路指点（《There Are Other Ways》）。

On a new island the sorceress Circe turns the scouting men into pigs (Puppeteer). Hermes gives Odysseus a protective herb, and he resists the magic and outwits Circe (Wouldn't You Like, Done For). Finally he persuades her with honesty to release the crew and guide his way ahead (There Are Other Ways).

5. 冥界之章5. The Underworld Saga

为问归途，奥德修斯下到冥界，见到死去的亡灵与母亲安提克勒亚（《The Underworld》）；先知忒瑞西阿斯预言，他归途还将牺牲至亲、并在未知之岛再遇险境（《No Longer You》）。奥德修斯由此下定决心，为回家宁可成为“怪物”（《Monster》）。

Seeking his way home, Odysseus descends to the underworld and meets the dead and his mother Anticlea (The Underworld). The seer Tiresias prophesies that he will yet lose those dear to him and face danger on an unknown island (No Longer You). Odysseus resolves to become a "monster" if that is what it takes to return (Monster).

（二）第二幕：归来与复仇Act 2 · Homecoming and Vengeance

1. 雷霆之章1. The Thunder Saga

面对以幻音诱人的海妖塞壬（《Suffering》《Different Beast》）；奥德修斯为闯过斯库拉水道，被迫主动牺牲六名船员（《Scylla》）；副手欧律洛科斯惊惧哗变，为了充饥在太阳神的岛上杀死了神牛（《Mutiny》）；宙斯降下天雷，逼奥德修斯在“自我牺牲”与“葬送船员”之间二选一，奥德修斯含泪处决了叛众（《Thunder Bringer》），从此孤身漂流。

Facing the Sirens who lure men with phantom voices (Suffering, Different Beast); to pass through the strait of Scylla, Odysseus is forced to sacrifice six of his own men (Scylla). Eurylochus, terrified, leads a mutiny and, to stave off hunger, slaughters the sacred cattle on the island of the sun-god (Mutiny). Zeus unleashes his thunder and forces Odysseus to choose between self-sacrifice and losing the crew — he executes the rebels in tears (Thunder Bringer), and drifts on alone.

2. 智慧之章2. The Wisdom Saga

视角转向伊萨卡。儿子忒勒玛科斯在母亲的守望中渴望证明自己（《Legendary》）；雅典娜化身引路、悉心教导他（《Little Wolf》《We'll Be Fine》）；与此同时，奥德修斯被困在仙女卡吕普索的海岛已七年（《Love in Paradise》）；雅典娜与众神展开一场“众神游戏”，为奥德修斯争取自由（《God Games》）。

The focus shifts to Ithaca. His son Telemachus longs to prove himself under his mother's watchful eye (Legendary). Athena appears in disguise and guides him (Little Wolf, We'll Be Fine). Meanwhile, Odysseus has been trapped for seven years on the island of the nymph Calypso (Love in Paradise). Athena argues with the gods in a "game of gods" to win Odysseus his freedom (God Games).

3. 复仇之章3. The Vengeance Saga

卡吕普索放行，奥德修斯重上归途（《Not Sorry for Loving You》）；赫尔墨斯告知他波塞冬仍怀杀意，并交予三叉戟（《Dangerous》）；他强渡卡律布狄斯漩涡（《Charybdis》）；波塞冬在海上拦路（《Get in the Water》）；奥德修斯以一己之力迎战海神，亲手将其击退（《Six Hundred Strike》）。

Calypso lets him go, and Odysseus resumes his journey (Not Sorry for Loving You). Hermes tells him of Poseidon's wrath and hands him a trident (Dangerous). He crosses the whirlpool Charybdis (Charybdis). Poseidon blocks his way at sea (Get in the Water). Odysseus fights the sea-god himself and drives him back (Six Hundred Strike).

4. 伊萨卡之章4. The Ithaca Saga

王后佩涅洛佩设下“弯弓射穿十二柄斧首”之约，静候良人（《The Challenge》）；求婚者密谋除掉可能归来的奥德修斯（《Hold Them Down》）；奥德修斯乔装回宫，与儿子忒勒玛科斯联手屠尽求婚者（《Odysseus》）；母子相认后，奥德修斯忐忑询问佩涅洛佩是否仍愿再爱他，以一场告白为二十年漂泊画上句点（《I Can't Help but Wonder》《Would You Fall in Love with Me Again》）。

Queen Penelope sets a trial of stringing the bow and shooting through twelve axe-heads, awaiting her true husband (The Challenge). The suitors conspire to kill the returning Odysseus (Hold Them Down). Disguised, Odysseus returns to the palace and, with his son Telemachus, slaughters the suitors (Odysseus). Reunited at last, Odysseus asks Penelope, almost afraid, whether she would fall in love with him again — a confession that closes the twenty-year voyage (I Can't Help but Wonder, Would You Fall in Love with Me Again).

CREATIVE TEAMCREATIVE TEAM

三、创作团队3. The Creative Team

（一）主创与制作Creator & Production

编剧、作词、作曲、音乐总监、主唱：豪尔赫·里维拉-埃兰斯（Jorge Rivera-Herrans）。他出生于波多黎各，就读于圣母大学期间以本剧作为毕业论文选题，2019 年动笔，2021 年起在 TikTok 上持续记录创作过程而收获大量关注；剧中奥德修斯一角由其本人全程配音。他独创“角色专属乐器与主题动机”体系，被评论界誉为“把《奥德赛》写得像一部可以听见的冒险”。

制作与发行：Winion Entertainment。该独立公司由里维拉-埃兰斯于 2023 年为夺回版权、独立发行而创办，承担此后全部专辑、周边与衍生项目的运营。早期曾与托尼奖提名制片人布莱尔·罗素（Blair Russell）合作，罗素前期协助独立发行与品牌运营，后双方因版权问题对簿公堂，最终里维拉-埃兰斯胜出并获得完整创作与发行控制权。

录音地点包括墨西哥城 Estudio 13、纽约 Quad Studios 与洛杉矶 JP Warner Sound。整个概念专辑的视觉、配乐乃至部分演员，都通过“社区共创”方式由全球粉丝参与完成，是其制作模式的最大特色。

Writer, lyricist, composer, music director, and lead: Jorge Rivera-Herrans. Born in Puerto Rico, he began this musical as his senior thesis while studying at the University of Notre Dame, starting in 2019 and documenting the creative process on TikTok from 2021, winning a large following. He voices Odysseus throughout. He devised a system of character-specific instruments and leitmotifs, praised by critics for "making the Odyssey feel like an adventure you can hear."

Production and release: Winion Entertainment. Jorge founded this independent company in 2023 to regain control of the copyright and release the work independently; it now handles all future albums, merchandise, and derivative projects. He initially worked with Tony-nominated producer Blair Russell, who helped with independent distribution and branding; the two later split amid a copyright dispute, and Rivera-Herrans ultimately retained full creative and distribution control.

Recording took place at Estudio 13 in Mexico City, Quad Studios in New York, and JP Warner Sound in Los Angeles. Much of the visual design, music, and even several performers came from a global "community co-creation" effort — the signature of its production model.

CHARACTERSCHARACTERS

四、角色介绍4. The Characters

奥德修斯（Odysseus）：伊萨卡国王，全剧核心。以智慧与口才著称的“多谋之人”，为回到妻儿身边，在二十年归途上从“怀抱善意”逐步走向“不惜成魔”，于人性与生存之间反复挣扎，是全剧道德张力的中心。

佩涅洛佩（Penelope）：王后，奥德修斯之妻。二十年坚守伊萨卡，以“白天织布、夜里拆线”之计拖延求婚者，又以弯弓之约静候丈夫归来，是维系全剧情感与希望的关键支点。

忒勒玛科斯（Telemachus）：王子，奥德修斯之子。在父亲缺席的岁月中成长，渴望证明自己，在雅典娜的引导下逐渐脱去怯懦，最终能与父亲并肩作战，成为合格的继承者。

雅典娜（Athena）：智慧与战争女神，奥德修斯的“精神导师”。从要求他恪守战士之道，到为救他直面众神，她的守护贯穿全剧，是仅次于奥德修斯的重要角色。

波塞冬（Poseidon）：海神，独眼巨人之父，全剧最持久的主要对手。信奉“残酷即是慈悲”，为报子仇誓要将奥德修斯葬于大海。

宙斯（Zeus）：众神之王。以神谕与天雷左右凡人命运，其“雷霆审判”逼奥德修斯做出全剧最痛的选择。

欧律洛科斯（Eurylochus）：奥德修斯的副手与妹夫，因恐惧与分歧屡次与主将争执，最终率众哗变，构成凡人视角下对照性的另一条叙事线。

波利忒斯（Polites）：奥德修斯挚友，主张“敞开双臂”的温柔哲学，其理念与奥德修斯日后的冷酷形成鲜明对照，其死亡成为剧情转折的催化剂。

喀耳刻（Circe）：魔女，曾将船员变猪，后被奥德修斯的坦诚打动而成为助力。

卡吕普索（Calypso）：困住奥德修斯七年的海岛仙女，痴恋却终肯放手。

赫尔墨斯（Hermes）：众神信使，两度为奥德修斯送上关键助力（魔草与三叉戟）。

Odysseus: King of Ithaca and the heart of the show. The "man of many turns," famed for wit and eloquence, who over twenty years shifts from "open arms" toward a willingness to become a monster to get home — the moral center of the piece.

Penelope: The queen, Odysseus's wife. She holds Ithaca for twenty years, stalling the suitors by weaving and unweaving, and sets the bow trial to await her true husband — the emotional anchor of the story.

Telemachus: The prince, Odysseus's son. He grows up without his father, longs to prove himself, and under Athena's guidance sheds his timidity until he can fight beside his father as a worthy heir.

Athena: Goddess of wisdom and war, Odysseus's "spiritual mentor." From demanding he hold to the warrior's way to confronting the gods to save him, her guardianship runs through the whole work.

Poseidon: Sea-god, father of the Cyclops, and the most persistent antagonist. He believes "ruthlessness is mercy upon ourselves" and vows to bury Odysseus at sea for his son.

Zeus: King of the gods. He shapes mortal fate through oracles and thunder; his "thunder judgment" forces the show's most painful choice upon Odysseus.

Eurylochus: Odysseus's second-in-command and brother-in-law, who clashes with his captain out of fear and disagreement and finally leads a mutiny — a contrasting mortal perspective.

Polites: Odysseus's dearest friend, who preaches an "open arms" gentleness that starkly contrasts with the coldness Odysseus later adopts; his death becomes a turning point.

Circe: The sorceress who turns men into pigs, later won over by Odysseus's honesty into an ally.

Calypso: The island nymph who keeps Odysseus for seven years; she loves him yet at last lets him go.

Hermes: The messenger of the gods, twice giving Odysseus crucial help (the herb and the trident).

THE SONGSTHE SONGS

五、歌曲介绍5. The Songs

全剧共 40 首歌曲，按 9 个 Saga 编排；每个章节既是叙事段落，也类似游戏中的“关卡”，常在章末推向与神祇或怪物对抗的“Boss 战”式高潮。各章曲目如下：

The work comprises 40 songs arranged across nine sagas. Each saga is both a narrative arc and, much like a video-game "level," often building toward a "boss battle" climax against a god or monster. The track list by saga follows:

值得一听的代表作Notable Highlights

《Warrior of the Mind》（雅典娜主题，炫技高音与师徒情谊兼具）；《Ruthlessness》（波塞冬首秀，全剧最出圈的“名场面”之一）；《Monster》（奥德修斯心态转变的分水岭）；《Thunder Bringer》（宙斯雷霆审判，压迫感十足）；《God Games》（雅典娜与众神轮番交涉，多位神祇同台）；《Six Hundred Strike》（奥德修斯对战波塞冬，热血收束）；《Would You Fall in Love with Me Again》（全剧结局曲，被许多听众评为最催泪的经典）。

Warrior of the Mind (Athena's theme, virtuoso high notes and a mentor-student bond); Ruthlessness (Poseidon's debut, one of the show's most iconic "moments"); Monster (the watershed of Odysseus's change of heart); Thunder Bringer (Zeus's thunder judgment, overwhelming pressure); God Games (Athena pleads with the gods, several deities on stage in turn); Six Hundred Strike (Odysseus against Poseidon, an epic climax); Would You Fall in Love with Me Again (the finale, called by many listeners the most moving song).

WHAT'S NEXTWHAT'S NEXT

六、延伸动态6. What's Next

截至 2026 年，EPIC 已从“概念专辑”向多元媒介拓展：据多家媒体报道，由杰瑞·布鲁克海默（Jerry Bruckheimer）制片的动画电影版正在筹备中（配音卡司尚未公布，档期未定）；舞台改编与多部电子游戏亦在开发计划之列。此外，里维拉-埃兰斯于 2025 年宣布开始创作第二部音乐剧《Ilium》，改编自荷马的另一部史诗《伊利亚特》。

As of 2026, EPIC has expanded beyond the concept album across media: according to multiple reports, an animated film produced by Jerry Bruckheimer is in development (voice cast not yet announced; no release date set); a stage adaptation and several video games are also planned. Rivera-Herrans also announced in 2025 that he had begun work on a second musical, Ilium, adapted from Homer's other epic, The Iliad.
